name: V2 Retail Ltd
title: V2 Retail Ltd - 532867 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +60% to Rs 797 cr with SSSG 7.74% and FY26 EBITDA margin 14.9%, but management guides 50% growth with 50-60% new area, so margins stay flat and no operating leverage until FY28.

capex.quote: So, the CAPEX would be about Rs. 1.2 crores-Rs. 1.3 crores and the rest would be paid inventory.

triggers.label: Store additions 170-200 in FY27
triggers.quote: the target would be anywhere between 170 -200 stores, completely dependent on how we are performing

triggers.label: Creditors cut ~10 days from prepayments
triggers.quote: if you look at the creditors, it has come down by almost 10 days

triggers.label: 50% revenue growth guided for 2 years
triggers.quote: we are guiding for at least 50% revenue growth over the next 2 years

triggers.label: May slowed due to war
triggers.quote: May has been a little slow and June is supposed to be one of the biggest months

triggers.label: Price hikes of 3-4% to pass on yarn costs
triggers.quote: prices might go up in the future by 3%-4%

guidance.quote: the target would be anywhere between 170 -200 stores, completely dependent on how we are performing
we are guiding for at least 50% revenue growth over the next 2 years
you can look for us to maintain this gross margin anywhere between 28 %-30%
we guide for 8% to 10% SSG going forward
We are looking to maintain inventory at 90-100 days and creditors at 45 days.
going forward will be less than 0.5%

red_flags.label: Inventory build ahead of store openings
red_flags.quote: we have additional inventory of about 125 to 150 for the 60 stores tha t we have planned to open this quarter

red_flags.label: Prepayments cut creditor days
red_flags.quote: because we had prepaid a lot of vendors, so if you look at the creditors, it has come down by almost 10 days

red_flags.label: Depreciation one-time counting change
red_flags.quote: Yes, it is a one-time counting change.

evasions.quote: I don't want to comment on any competitors
it's too early to say like I said, April was very good for us
